en: The Bremen Town Musicians, shout out to Christian for suggesting today's tale.
zh: 不來梅的城市音樂家，感謝Christian建議今天的故事。
ja: ブレーメンの音楽隊、今日の物語を提案してくれたクリスチャンに感謝します。
local: The Bremen Town Musicians, shout out to Christian for suggesting today's tale.
ja_pron: Bureemen no ongakutai, kyou no monogatari o teian shite kureta Kurisuchan ni kansha shimasu.
native: The Bremen Town Musicians, shout out to Christian for suggesting today's tale.

en: You've become useless with age. Perhaps it's time I fed you to the wolves.
zh: 你年紀大了變得沒用了。也許該是我把你餵給狼的時候了。
ja: 年を取って役に立たなくなったね。そろそろ狼に食べさせる時かもしれない。
local: You've become useless with age. Perhaps it's time I fed you to the wolves.
ja_pron: Toshi o totte yaku ni tatanaku natta ne. Sorosoro ōkami ni tabesaseru toki kamoshirenai.
native: You've become useless with age. Perhaps it's time I fed you to the wolves.

en: Move!
ja: 動け！
local: Move!
ja_pron: Ugoke!
native: Move!

en: Worthless!
ja: 役立たず！
local: Worthless!
ja_pron: Yakutatazu!
native: Worthless!

en: Ah, music! They have musicians in Bremen.
zh: 啊，音樂！不來梅有音樂家。
ja: ああ、音楽だ！ブレーメンには音楽家がいるんだ。
local: Ah, music! They have musicians in Bremen.
ja_pron: Aa, ongaku da! Bureemen ni wa ongakuka ga irun da.
native: Ah, music! They have musicians in Bremen.

en: If they don't need an old worker, maybe Bremen needs a new musician.
zh: 如果他們不需要老工人，也許不來梅需要新的音樂家。
ja: もし彼らが年老いた労働者を必要としないなら、ブレーメンは新しい音楽家を必要としているのかもしれない。
local: If they don't need an old worker, maybe Bremen needs a new musician.
ja_pron: Moshi karera ga toshioita roudousha o hitsuyou to shinai nara, Bureemen wa atarashii ongakuka o hitsuyou to shite iru no kamoshirenai.
native: If they don't need an old worker, maybe Bremen needs a new musician.

en: Bremen Town, here I come.
ja: ブレーメンの町、行くぞ。
local: Bremen Town, here I come.
ja_pron: Bureemen no machi, iku zo.
native: Bremen Town, here I come.

en: Good morning. You look as though you've raced the wind and lost.
zh: 早安。你看起來像是和風賽跑卻輸了。
ja: おはよう。風と競争して負けたように見えるね。
local: Good morning. You look as though you've raced the wind and lost.
ja_pron: Ohayou. Kaze to kyousou shite maketa you ni mieru ne.
native: Good morning. You look as though you've raced the wind and lost.

en: Feels more like the wind outran me.
zh: 感覺更像是風跑得比我快。
ja: むしろ風に置いていかれた感じだ。
local: Feels more like the wind outran me.
ja_pron: Mushiro kaze ni oite ikareta kanji da.
native: Feels more like the wind outran me.

en: What happened?
ja: どうしたんだ？
local: What happened?
ja_pron: Doushitan da?
native: What happened?

en: I was a hunting dog.
ja: 私は猟犬だった。
local: I was a hunting dog.
ja_pron: Watashi wa ryouken datta.
native: I was a hunting dog.

en: The best. Once. No fox escaped me.
zh: 曾經是最棒的。沒有狐狸能逃過我。
ja: かつては最高だった。キツネは一匹も逃げられなかった。
local: The best. Once. No fox escaped me.
ja_pron: Katsute wa saikou datta. Kitsune wa ippiki mo nigerarenakatta.
native: The best. Once. No fox escaped me.

en: No rabbit outran me. No deer slipped past my nose.
zh: 沒有兔子跑得比我快。沒有鹿從我鼻子旁溜過。
ja: ウサギも私から逃げ切れなかった。シカも鼻先をすり抜けなかった。
local: No rabbit outran me. No deer slipped past my nose.
ja_pron: Usagi mo watashi kara nigekirenakatta. Shika mo hanasaki o surinukenakatta.
native: No rabbit outran me. No deer slipped past my nose.

en: But today my legs couldn't keep up. The hunter called me useless.
zh: 但今天我的腿跟不上了。獵人說我沒用了。
ja: でも今日は足がついていけなかった。猟師は私を役立たずと呼んだ。
local: But today my legs couldn't keep up. The hunter called me useless.
ja_pron: Demo kyou wa ashi ga tsuite ikenakatta. Ryoushi wa watashi o yakutatazu to yonda.
native: But today my legs couldn't keep up. The hunter called me useless.

en: He said I'd only slow the younger dogs. I heard him say he wouldn't be feeding me much longer.
zh: 他說我只會拖慢年輕的狗。我聽到他說不會再餵我太久了。
ja: 彼は私が若い犬たちの足を引っ張るだけだと言った。もう長くは餌をやらないとも聞いた。
local: He said I'd only slow the younger dogs. I heard him say he wouldn't be feeding me much longer.
ja_pron: Kare wa watashi ga wakai inu-tachi no ashi o hipparu dake da to itta. Mou nagaku wa esa o yaranai to mo kiita.
native: He said I'd only slow the younger dogs. I heard him say he wouldn't be feeding me much longer.

en: So, I left before he could decide my fate.
zh: 所以，我在他決定我的命運之前離開了。
ja: だから、彼が私の運命を決める前に去ったんだ。
local: So, I left before he could decide my fate.
ja_pron: Dakara, kare ga watashi no unmei o kimeru mae ni satta nda.
native: So, I left before he could decide my fate.

en: Then we're alike.
ja: じゃあ、私たちは似ているね。
local: Then we're alike.
ja_pron: Jaa, watashitachi wa nite iru ne.
native: Then we're alike.

en: You two?
ja: 君たち二人？
local: You two?
ja_pron: Kimitachi futari?
native: You two?

en: Yesterday I was a hard working farm donkey. Today?
zh: 昨天我還是勤勞的農場驢子。今天呢？
ja: 昨日までは働き者の農場のロバだった。今日？
local: Yesterday I was a hard working farm donkey. Today?
ja_pron: Kinou made wa hatarakimono no noujou no roba datta. Kyou?
native: Yesterday I was a hard working farm donkey. Today?

en: I'm apparently yesterday's news.
ja: 私はどうやら昨日のニュースらしい。
local: I'm apparently yesterday's news.
ja_pron: Watashi wa dou yara kinou no nyuusu rashii.
native: I'm apparently yesterday's news.

en: I'm on my way to Bremen.
ja: 私はブレーメンに向かっている。
local: I'm on my way to Bremen.
ja_pron: Watashi wa Bureemen ni mukatte iru.
native: I'm on my way to Bremen.

en: Bremen, what waits for you there?
zh: 不來梅，等待你的會是什麼？
ja: ブレーメンでは何が君を待っている？
local: Bremen, what waits for you there?
ja_pron: Bureemen de wa nani ga kimi o matte iru?
native: Bremen, what waits for you there?

en: A new career. I'm going to be a town musician.
zh: 一份新職業。我將成為城市音樂家。
ja: 新しい職業だ。私は街の音楽家になるつもりだ。
local: A new career. I'm going to be a town musician.
ja_pron: Atarashii shokugyou da. Watashi wa machi no ongakuka ni naru tsumori da.
native: A new career. I'm going to be a town musician.

en: You're serious?
ja: 本気なの？
local: You're serious?
ja_pron: Honki nano?
native: You're serious?

en: Completely. I have a voice.
ja: もちろん。本当に声がある。
local: Completely. I have a voice.
ja_pron: Mochiron. Hontou ni koe ga aru.
native: Completely. I have a voice.

en: And I have a mighty bar.
ja: そして強力な吠え声も持っている。
local: And I have a mighty bar.
ja_pron: Soshite kyouryoku na hoegoe mo motte iru.
native: And I have a mighty bar.

en: Together, we'll make twice the music.
zh: 我們一起，將創造雙倍的音樂。
ja: 一緒に、二倍の音楽を作ろう。
local: Together, we'll make twice the music.
ja_pron: Issho ni, nibai no ongaku o tsukurou.
native: Together, we'll make twice the music.

en: I'm not sure people would pay to hear me bark.
zh: 我不確定人們會付錢聽我吠叫。
ja: 人々が私の吠え声を聞くためにお金を払うかはわからない。
local: I'm not sure people would pay to hear me bark.
ja_pron: Hitobito ga watashi no hoegoe o kiku tame ni okane o harau ka wa wakaranai.
native: I'm not sure people would pay to hear me bark.

en: Perhaps not, but they'll certainly remember us.
zh: 也許不會，但他們肯定會記得我們。
ja: たぶんそうではないけど、彼らは確実に私たちを覚えているだろう。
local: Perhaps not, but they'll certainly remember us.
ja_pron: Tabun sou de wa nai kedo, karera wa kakujitsu ni watashitachi o oboete iru darou.
native: Perhaps not, but they'll certainly remember us.

en: You really don't mind traveling with an old dog?
zh: 你真的不介意和一隻老狗一起旅行嗎？
ja: 本当に年老いた犬と旅をするのは気にしないの？
local: You really don't mind traveling with an old dog?
ja_pron: Hontou ni toshioita inu to tabi o suru no wa ki ni shinai no?
native: You really don't mind traveling with an old dog?

en: Not at all. The road is much shorter with a friend.
zh: 一點也不。和朋友一起路程會短很多。
ja: 全然気にしない。友達がいれば道はずっと短く感じる。
local: Not at all. The road is much shorter with a friend.
ja_pron: Zenzen ki ni shinai. Tomodachi ga ireba michi wa zutto mijikaku kanjiru.
native: Not at all. The road is much shorter with a friend.

en: Then I'd be honored to join your orchestra.
zh: 那我很榮幸加入你們的樂團。
ja: それなら、喜んで君たちのオーケストラに参加するよ。
local: Then I'd be honored to join your orchestra.
ja_pron: Sorenara, yorokonde kimitachi no ookesutora ni sanka suru yo.
native: Then I'd be honored to join your orchestra.

en: Excellent! Our audience won't know what hit them.
zh: 太好了！我們的觀眾不會知道發生了什麼。
ja: 素晴らしい！観客は何が起きたのかわからないだろう。
local: Excellent! Our audience won't know what hit them.
ja_pron: Subarashii! Kankyaku wa nani ga okita no ka wakaranai darou.
native: Excellent! Our audience won't know what hit them.

en: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm.
ja: うんうん、うんうん、うんうん。
local: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm.
ja_pron: Un un, un un, un un.
native: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

en: And!
ja: そして！
local: And!
ja_pron: Soshite!
native: And!

en: Good afternoon. That's the saddest meow I've ever heard.
zh: 午安。那是我聽過最悲傷的喵聲。
ja: こんにちは。それは今まで聞いた中で一番悲しい鳴き声だ。
local: Good afternoon. That's the saddest meow I've ever heard.
ja_pron: Konnichiwa. Sore wa ima made kiita naka de ichiban kanashii nakigoe da.
native: Good afternoon. That's the saddest meow I've ever heard.

en: It's been that kind of day.
ja: そんな日だったんだ。
local: It's been that kind of day.
ja_pron: Sonna hi dattan da.
native: It's been that kind of day.

en: What's happened?
ja: 何があったの？
local: What's happened?
ja_pron: Nani ga atta no?
native: What's happened?

en: The farmer said that I am too old and that he has no use for me anymore.
zh: 農夫說我太老了，他不再需要我了。
ja: 農夫は私が年を取りすぎてもう必要ないと言った。
local: The farmer said that I am too old and that he has no use for me anymore.
ja_pron: Noufu wa watashi ga toshi o torisugite mou hitsuyou nai to itta.
native: The farmer said that I am too old and that he has no use for me anymore.

en: I spent my whole life protecting that house.
zh: 我一生都在保護那棟房子。
ja: 私は一生その家を守ってきた。
local: I spent my whole life protecting that house.
ja_pron: Watashi wa isshou sono ie o mamotte kita.
native: I spent my whole life protecting that house.

en: Now my paws aren't as quick.
zh: 現在我的爪子不再那麼靈活。
ja: 今は私の足もとがあまり速くない。
local: Now my paws aren't as quick.
ja_pron: Ima wa watashi no ashimoto ga amari hayakunai.
native: Now my paws aren't as quick.

en: And suddenly I've become a burden.
ja: そして突然、私は重荷になってしまった。
local: And suddenly I've become a burden.
ja_pron: Soshite totsuzen, watashi wa omoni ni natte shimatta.
native: And suddenly I've become a burden.

en: Sounds familiar.
ja: 聞き覚えがある。
local: Sounds familiar.
ja_pron: Kiki oboe ga aru.
native: Sounds familiar.

en: You too?
ja: 君も？
local: You too?
ja_pron: Kimi mo?
native: You too?

en: Yes.
ja: はい。
local: Yes.
ja_pron: Hai.
native: Yes.

en: Then I suppose we're members of the same unfortunate club.
zh: 那我想我們是同一個不幸俱樂部的成員。
ja: それなら、私たちは同じ不運なクラブのメンバーだろう。
local: Then I suppose we're members of the same unfortunate club.
ja_pron: Sorenara, watashitachi wa onaji fuun na kurabu no menbaa darou.
native: Then I suppose we're members of the same unfortunate club.

en: Perhaps, but we've started a much better one.
zh: 也許，但我們開始了一個更好的俱樂部。
ja: たぶん、でも私たちはもっと良いクラブを始めた。
local: Perhaps, but we've started a much better one.
ja_pron: Tabun, demo watashitachi wa motto yoi kurabu o hajimeta.
native: Perhaps, but we've started a much better one.

en: Oh?
ja: ああ？
local: Oh?
ja_pron: Aa?
native: Oh?

en: We're traveling to Bremen to become town musicians.
zh: 我們正前往不來梅成為城市音樂家。
ja: 私たちはブレーメンに向かい、街の音楽家になるんだ。
local: We're traveling to Bremen to become town musicians.
ja_pron: Watashitachi wa Bureemen ni mukai, machi no ongakuka ni narun da.
native: We're traveling to Bremen to become town musicians.

en: You're serious?
ja: 本気なの？
local: You're serious?
ja_pron: Honki nano?
native: You're serious?

en: Completely serious.
ja: 本当に真剣だ。
local: Completely serious.
ja_pron: Hontou ni shinken da.
native: Completely serious.

en: Questionable talent? Excellent enthusiasm.
ja: 才能は疑わしい？素晴らしい熱意だ。
local: Questionable talent? Excellent enthusiasm.
ja_pron: Sainou wa utagawashii? Subarashii netsui da.
native: Questionable talent? Excellent enthusiasm.

en: I'm afraid my singing mostly happens at night.
zh: 恐怕我大多在晚上唱歌。
ja: 残念ながら私の歌は主に夜に歌われる。
local: I'm afraid my singing mostly happens at night.
ja_pron: Zannen nagara watashi no uta wa omoni yoru ni utawareru.
native: I'm afraid my singing mostly happens at night.

en: People usually throw boots at me.
zh: 人們通常會朝我丟靴子。
ja: 人々はたいてい私にブーツを投げる。
local: People usually throw boots at me.
ja_pron: Hitobito wa taitei watashi ni buutsu o nageru.
native: People usually throw boots at me.

en: Then they'll definitely remember your performance.
zh: 那他們肯定會記得你的表演。
ja: それなら彼らは確実に君の演奏を覚えているだろう。
local: Then they'll definitely remember your performance.
ja_pron: Sore nara karera wa kakujitsu ni kimi no ensou o oboete iru darou.
native: Then they'll definitely remember your performance.

en: Besides, every orchestra needs variety.
zh: 而且，每個樂團都需要多樣性。
ja: それに、どんなオーケストラにも多様性が必要だ。
local: Besides, every orchestra needs variety.
ja_pron: Sore ni, donna ookesutora ni mo tayousei ga hitsuyou da.
native: Besides, every orchestra needs variety.

en: Perhaps it's time I stop chasing mice.
zh: 也許該是我停止追老鼠的時候了。
ja: そろそろネズミを追いかけるのをやめる時かもしれない。
local: Perhaps it's time I stop chasing mice.
ja_pron: Sorosoro nezumi o oikakeru no o yameru toki kamoshirenai.
native: Perhaps it's time I stop chasing mice.

en: Very well.
ja: わかった。
local: Very well.
ja_pron: Wakatta.
native: Very well.

en: Where does a future star performer stand?
zh: 未來的明星表演者站在哪裡？
ja: 未来のスターはどこに立つ？
local: Where does a future star performer stand?
ja_pron: Mirai no sutaa wa doko ni tatsu?
native: Where does a future star performer stand?

en: Right beside her fellow musicians.
zh: 就在她的同伴音樂家旁邊。
ja: 仲間の音楽家のすぐ隣に。
local: Right beside her fellow musicians.
ja_pron: Nakama no ongakuka no sugu tonari ni.
native: Right beside her fellow musicians.

en: Welcome to the finest orchestra that doesn't exist yet.
zh: 歡迎來到尚未存在的最棒樂團。
ja: まだ存在しない最高のオーケストラへようこそ。
local: Welcome to the finest orchestra that doesn't exist yet.
ja_pron: Mada sonzai shinai saikou no ookesutora e youkoso.
native: Welcome to the finest orchestra that doesn't exist yet.

en: That's quite a voice.
ja: なかなかの声だね。
local: That's quite a voice.
ja_pron: Nakanaka no koe da ne.
native: That's quite a voice.

en: Why does it sound like you're announcing the end of the world?
zh: 為什麼聽起來像是在宣告世界末日？
ja: なぜ世界の終わりを告げているように聞こえるんだ？
local: Why does it sound like you're announcing the end of the world?
ja_pron: Naze sekai no owari o tsugete iru you ni kikoeru nda?
native: Why does it sound like you're announcing the end of the world?

en: Because for me, it is.
ja: 私にとっては、そうなんだ。
local: Because for me, it is.
ja_pron: Watashi ni totte wa, sou nan da.
native: Because for me, it is.

en: What do you mean?
ja: どういう意味？
local: What do you mean?
ja_pron: Dou iu imi?
native: What do you mean?

en: I've greeted every sunrise on this farm.
zh: 我在這個農場迎接過每個日出。
ja: 私はこの農場で毎日の夜明けを迎えてきた。
local: I've greeted every sunrise on this farm.
ja_pron: Watashi wa kono noujou de mainichi no yoake o mukaete kita.
native: I've greeted every sunrise on this farm.

en: Tomorrow will be my last.
zh: 明天將是我的最後一天。
ja: 明日が私の最後の日になる。
local: Tomorrow will be my last.
ja_pron: Ashita ga watashi no saigo no hi ni naru.
native: Tomorrow will be my last.

en: The farmer plans to have me for dinner.
ja: 農夫は私を夕食にするつもりだ。
local: The farmer plans to have me for dinner.
ja_pron: Noufu wa watashi o yuushoku ni suru tsumori da.
native: The farmer plans to have me for dinner.

en: You don't have to stay.
ja: ここにいる必要はないよ。
local: You don't have to stay.
ja_pron: Koko ni iru hitsuyou wa nai yo.
native: You don't have to stay.

en: Where would I go?
ja: どこへ行けばいい？
local: Where would I go?
ja_pron: Doko e ikeba ii?
native: Where would I go?

en: This place is all I've ever known.
zh: 這個地方是我唯一熟悉的。
ja: ここが私の知っているすべての場所だ。
local: This place is all I've ever known.
ja_pron: Koko ga watashi no shitte iru subete no basho da.
native: This place is all I've ever known.

en: That's exactly what I thought about my stable.
zh: 我對我的馬廄也是這麼想的。
ja: 私も自分の厩舎についてそう思っていた。
local: That's exactly what I thought about my stable.
ja_pron: Watashi mo jibun no kyūsha ni tsuite sou omotte ita.
native: That's exactly what I thought about my stable.

en: And I thought my hunting trail was my whole world.
zh: 我也以為我的狩獵路徑就是我的整個世界。
ja: そして私も狩猟の道が自分の全世界だと思っていた。
local: And I thought my hunting trail was my whole world.
ja_pron: Soshite watashi mo shuryou no michi ga jibun no zen sekai da to omotte ita.
native: And I thought my hunting trail was my whole world.

en: I couldn't imagine life beyond my farmhouse.
zh: 我無法想像農舍之外的生活。
ja: 農場の家の外の生活は想像できなかった。
local: I couldn't imagine life beyond my farmhouse.
ja_pron: Noujou no ie no soto no seikatsu wa souzou dekinakatta.
native: I couldn't imagine life beyond my farmhouse.

en: Where are you all going?
ja: みんなどこへ行くの？
local: Where are you all going?
ja_pron: Minna doko e iku no?
native: Where are you all going?

en: To Braman.
ja: ブレーメンへ。
local: To Braman.
ja_pron: Bureemen e.
native: To Braman.

en: We're starting a musical group.
zh: 我們要組成一個音樂團體。
ja: 私たちは音楽グループを始めるんだ。
local: We're starting a musical group.
ja_pron: Watashitachi wa ongaku guruupu o hajimerun da.
native: We're starting a musical group.

en: A donkey, a dog, and a cat.
zh: 一隻驢子、一隻狗和一隻貓。
ja: ロバと犬と猫。
local: A donkey, a dog, and a cat.
ja_pron: Roba to inu to neko.
native: A donkey, a dog, and a cat.

en: We've been told our performances are unforgettable.
zh: 有人說我們的表演令人難忘。
ja: 私たちの演奏は忘れられないと言われている。
local: We've been told our performances are unforgettable.
ja_pron: Watashitachi no ensou wa wasurerarenai to iwarete iru.
native: We've been told our performances are unforgettable.

en: Mostly by people begging us to stop.
zh: 大多是人們求我們停止。
ja: ほとんどは人々がやめてくれと懇願しているんだ。
local: Mostly by people begging us to stop.
ja_pron: Hotondo wa hitobito ga yamete kure to kongan shite irun da.
native: Mostly by people begging us to stop.

ja_pron: jinsei ga zenbu kuzureta to omotte ita
native: Thinking my whole life had fallen apart.

en: But every road can lead somewhere new.

ja_pron: demo, dono michi mo atarashii basho e tsuzuku koto ga dekiru
native: But every road can lead somewhere new.

ja_pron: kibō ga anata to tomo ni ayumu to kimeta toki
native: When hope decides to walk with you.

ja_pron: anata no ato no ichinen o negau
native: I wish you for a year after you.

native: Till my whole life filled up with fear.

en: But friends can help you find your stride.

local: But friends can help you find your stride.
ja_pron: demo tomodachi wa anata ga hohaba o mitsukeru no o tasukete kureru
native: But friends can help you find your stride.

en: When you've got someone by your side.

ja_pron: dareka ga soba ni iru toki
native: When you've got someone by your side.

en: Women ever reach Bramin's town.

local: Women ever reach Bramin's town.
ja_pron: josei-tachi wa itsuka buramin no machi ni tadoritsuku
native: Women ever reach Bramin's town.

en: But we'll never wear another frown.

ja_pron: demo watashitachi wa mō nidoto shikame tsura o shinai
